paragraphs: Harris provides mission critical software and service solutions for the public sector. The same page names utilities, private sector and insurance markets globally alongside healthcare.

It operates less as a single product line than as a group whose focus is to acquire businesses with growth potential, manage them well and then build them for the future. The solutions page describes an expanding portfolio of software businesses operating across diverse industries worldwide. That structure grew from an early bet on writing one product for the shared needs of many customers in a single industry, what the company history calls vertical market software.

In July of 1976, LEBS became the N. Harris Computer Corporation, and Nigel Harris became its first CEO. Research pointed to the utility industry as the right first target for that new way of writing and charging for software. In 1996, twenty years after the founding of N. Harris Computer Corporation, Nigel sold to Constellation Software Inc.

quote.text: All these years later, I’m grateful for the job that Constellation and the Harris leadership team have done with my baby.
